text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        cache: 'yarn'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      
    - name: Lint
      run: yarn lint
      
    - name: Test
      run: yarn test
      
    - name: Build
      run: yarn build
```
